c0f30f9edf79c65b77f666851546ec72a486c58d.summary: The page is a conference speaker biography listing for the presentation 'Unveiling the CryptoMimic' at the VB2020 conference. It gives short bios for three NTT Security staff members (Hajime Takai, Shogo Hayashi, Rintaro Koike), covering their SOC, malware analysis and speaking experience. It contains no threat findings, actors, tools, techniques, CVEs, dates of incidents or figures about any campaign, so it is not a threat report.
